title: Exploring the broad-spectrum activity of carbohydrate-based Iberin analogues: From anticancer effect to antioxidant properties.
authors: Prieto, L A; Khiar-Fernandez, N; Calderon-Montano, J M; Lopez-Lazaro, M; Lucia-Tamudo, J; Nogueira, J J; Leon, R; Moreno, N; Valdivia, V; Recio, R; Fernandez, I
one_liner_zh: 该文合成并评估糖基异硫氰酸酯类似物的抗癌与抗氧化活性，仅通过计算模拟初步涉及与STAT3 SH2域的蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Iberin is a lower homologue of sulforaphane (SFN) which has shown effectiveness in addressing various pathologies, including its anti-inflammatory properties, antitumor activity against various cancers, and antimicrobial effects. Building on this activity, a series of carbohydrate-based analogues of the natural isothiocyanate (ITC) iberin were synthesized, and their anticancer and antioxidant activities were evaluated. Cytotoxicity studies on three cancer cell lines using Resazurin assay demonstrated significant cytotoxic activity, particularly against bladder cancer. The sulfonyl derivatives exhibited the most potent effects, with IC(50) values comparable to those of reference natural isothiocyanates (from 10 to 20 muM). Computational simulations support the hypothesis that carbohydrate-based ITCs can interact with STAT3's SH2 domain in a manner similar to SFN, laying the groundwork for their potential development as STAT3-targeted anticancer agents. The antioxidant potential of these compounds was assessed by their ability to activate the Nrf2 factor, yielding CD values (concentration required to double luciferase activity compared to basal conditions) between 1.55 and 10.36 muM, without cytotoxicity at these concentrations. Notably, the phenylsulfone derivative 22beta displayed slightly higher or comparable antioxidant activity to that of natural isothiocyanates. Based on these findings, this phenylsulfone analogue was selected as the optimal compound due to its dual anticancer and antioxidant activities. An additional advantage of this carbohydrate-based ITC is that it is a solid compound, making it easier to handle than natural isothiocyanates, which are typically liquids.
abstract_zh: Iberin是萝卜硫素（sulforaphane, SFN）的低级同系物，已被证明在应对多种病理状况方面具有有效性，包括其抗炎特性、针对多种癌症的抗肿瘤活性以及抗菌作用。基于这一活性，合成了一系列基于碳水化合物的天然异硫氰酸酯（isothiocyanate, ITC）iberin类似物，并评估了其抗癌和抗氧化活性。使用Resazurin法对三种癌细胞系进行的细胞毒性研究表明，这些化合物具有显著的细胞毒性活性，尤其对膀胱癌效果突出。磺酰衍生物表现出最强的效应，其IC(50)值与参考天然异硫氰酸酯相当（范围为10至20 μM）。计算模拟支持以下假设：基于碳水化合物的ITC能够以类似于SFN的方式与STAT3的SH2结构域相互作用，为其作为靶向STAT3的抗癌药物的潜在开发奠定了基础。这些化合物的抗氧化潜力通过其激活Nrf2因子的能力进行评估，得到的CD值（与基础条件相比使荧光素酶活性加倍所需的浓度）介于1.55至10.36 μM之间，且在这些浓度下无细胞毒性。值得注意的是，苯磺酰衍生物22beta表现出略高于或与天然异硫氰酸酯相当的抗氧化活性。基于这些发现，该苯磺酰类似物因其双重抗癌和抗氧化活性而被选为最优化合物。这种基于碳水化合物的ITC的另一个优势在于它是一种固体化合物，比通常为液体的天然异硫氰酸酯更易于处理。
